title: Zesty Dense Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish featuring lamb, dasima-kombu, and a blend of Tunisian spices, cooked to perfection in a bain-marie.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the dasima-kombu pieces and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to a bain-marie, or a large pot of simmering water, and cook, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the bain-marie and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
